blocks.x: AI Proof-of-Concept & Value Validation sits in the Applied AI & GenAI tower, and it earns that place by being specific: Replace hype with evidence — feasibility, value and adoption risk proven on your data in 6-10 weeks. The build pattern, the artifacts and the guardrails follow.
What we deliver under this name

A good PoC answers three questions with numbers: does it work on our data, is it worth building, and will the organization absorb it? We design PoCs with a falsifiable success criterion up front, an evaluation set built from your records, a controls sketch that shows the production path, and an adoption probe with the actual operating team — so the go/no-go decision is defensible in a capital committee.

Deliberately, we also do the no-go work: a third of our PoCs end with a documented stop or a redirected approach, which is exactly the point. Every engagement ends with a value memo — measured performance, projected business impact at production scale, total cost to build and run, and risks with owners — feeding directly into the investment sequence.

The sectors where AI Proof-of-Concept & Value Validation currently runs: Banking & Financial Services, Insurance & Risk, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Manufacturing & Industrial. Each engagement anchors to one named metric in that sector's own language.
